theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the sole eligible leader with a clean absolute-trend tag and NO crowding flag, a rare combination in a mean-reverting tape. Its rise into rank 1 while the broader market is mean-reverting suggests idiosyncratic durability rather than broad-beta trend. The detector's only validated edge is drawdown control, and Coal's non-crowded status plus eligible gate means it is the one theme where the trend-following lens is at least not contradicted. This is a size-down-caution-compatible lean, not a momentum call.
evidence: one_narrative=true — the tape is dominated by this theme
theses.dissent: Coal has breadth of only 0.30, meaning leadership is narrow and driven by very few names; a single policy shift on energy or a commodity price reversal could unwind the theme quickly. The market's mean-reverting history (gate_helps=false) means even eligible trends tend to whipsaw.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS gives up its year-to-date relative lead over CSI 300 by more than 8% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are rank 2 and eligible, but are CROWDED (crowding_z 1.83, crowded=true) and have high durability_bar (0.82) which, in a mean-reverting market with no gate edge, reads as an extension risk rather than a trend confirmation. Crowding is a size-down caution only, but when combined with an absolute-trend gate that is known NOT to help in this market, the prudent read is to avoid adding exposure to the crowded challenger.
evidence: rotation.margin only 0.043 — Coal lead over Banks is thin
theses.dissent: Banks have breadth 0.833 (the widest of any theme) and a 'trend' hurst_tag, which in a different regime would support continuation. High crowding alone has no predictive fade edge per the guardrails, so this avoid is a risk-hygiene stance, not a short.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS outperforms CSI 300 by more than 6% over the next 20 trading days while its crowding_z does not fall below 1.5

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: This theme is eligible (absolute-trend gate has passed) YET simultaneously CROWDED (crowding_z 1.17, crowded=true) and resting at rank 11 with a negative score. In a market where the trend gate has no historical drawdown edge, an eligible-but-crowded-and-low-ranked theme is the worst combination: the gate provides no protection and the flow is already extended. Avoid as a size-down caution across the crowded eligible-eligible-eligible trio.
evidence: gate_helps=false — trend gate offers no edge here
theses.dissent: Pharma/CXO is a mean-reversion candidate precisely because it is low-ranked and extended; a sharp reversal to the upside on a policy catalyst could reward a contrarian position. However, the detector guardrails forbid treating extension as a fade signal, so this remains an avoid, not a fade.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ advances more than 10% relative to CSI 300 while its crowded flag flips to false
